name: CSG and Inter-object Intersection — Solid Voxel CSG
definition: A boolean operation that computes the exclusive OR (XOR) of multiple voxel grids, removing overlapping parts and keeping only the boxes that are unique to all grids.
summary: Solid Voxel CSG computes exclusive OR operations directly on identical voxel grids, differing from its parent by operating on pre-voxelized data rather than rendering slicemaps with blending.
